audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed across layers. Full phases[].side read Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ryze; content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ryze/Ekko. The full layer even handed Ryze the 2+ item row that the content layer gives you.
audit.why: Ryze's Spell Flux is 3.5s at rank 1 and Overload is 5s with every other cast resetting it, so his early is a poke pattern, not a kill pattern — levels 1-3 are genuinely even. Realm Warp at 180s is the one row that is his. Ekko takes 57.25% over 952 games, which is not a champion who loses the last row.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved onto the content values, with every flipped why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whys and spikes attributed your levels 4-5 edge to "Sheen-enabled burst" and "E poke", but Ekko's E is a 325-range dash with an auto reset, not a poke tool — his poke is the Q at 1075. The row-4 why also described level 5 while its label is Level 6.
audit.why: ownerKit E: range 325, dash + autoReset. ownerKit Q: range 1075, projectile + slow + zone. phases[4].label is Level 6.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 now credit the Q pass plus the E auto reset for what each actually does, and the Level 6 row now talks about level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was stated wrongly: the page called Rune Prison a root. It is a damage-and-slow by default and only becomes a root if the target already has Flux on them. That inverts the counterplay — the tell is Spell Flux landing, not Rune Prison being up.
audit.why: enemyKit W text: traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement; if the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted. enemyKit E applies the Flux debuff on a 3.5s cooldown at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, dos and trading now say that Flux is the enabler: unfluxed you are only slowed, so the moment to step is before Spell Flux lands, and the 3.5s E is the clock that matters rather than the 11s W.
sources: brief enemyKit W and E text

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Spell Flux 3.5s, Overload 5s and reset by his other casts, Rune Prison 11s, Realm Warp 180s.

notes: Six of seven chart rows were split across layers, including a direct inversion of the last row: full gave Ryze the 2+ item stage while content and the packet give it to Ekko. Full moved onto content throughout, each why rewritten with it; win[] already held the correct tokens so no content-side chart edit was proposable. The load-bearing correction here is that the page called Rune Prison a root outright, including in the focus token 'Ryze Rune Prison (Root)' and the loading line. Riot's text is explicit: it damages and slows, and roots ONLY if the target already has Flux. I could not edit focus.text or loading without changing the page's focus token, so I left both — FLAG FOR THE COORDINATOR: focus.text reads 'Ryze Rune Prison (Root)' and loading repeats it three times, all asserting a root that is conditional. Also corrected: the content layer credited Ekko's levels 4-5 edge to 'E poke' when E is a 325-range dash, and wants.you[0] told the reader to farm with it.
